name: Kirishima Sana
source:
Sana is a junior and is in charge of discipline at the school. She is fastidious in making sure the rules of the school are strictly followed. She is harsh about maintaining order and will not let injustice be allowed. Because of her position as the rule-enforcer of the school, she does not have many friends. Her weak point is complimenting, and her special ability is inspection.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/empusa/empusa.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
